name: Being Prideful
overview: Scripture warns against prideful attitudes that seek honor and status, as exemplified by the Pharisees who loved the highest seats and public recognition (Luke 11:43). True entrance into God's kingdom requires humility and childlike conversion (Matthew 18:3), rejecting vain pursuits that lead to spiritual poverty (Proverbs 28:19). God detests pride among other sins (Proverbs 6:16), and believers are called to live honestly and repay no evil with evil (Romans 12:17), recognizing that salvation and truth come only through Christ (John 14:6).
